<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, useAttrs, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { ChevronDownIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';
import { Button, type ButtonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useCodeBlockContext } from '@/components/ui/code-block/code-block-state';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  /** Text while the block is collapsed. */
  expandLabel?: string;
  /** Text while the block is expanded. */
  collapseLabel?: string;
  /** Visual style of the button. */
  variant?: ButtonVariants['variant'];
  /** Size of the button. */
  size?: ButtonVariants['size'];
}>(), {
  expandLabel: 'Show more',
  collapseLabel: 'Show less',
  variant: 'ghost',
  size: 'xs',
});

defineSlots<{
  /** Replaces the label and the chevron. */
  default?: (props: { expanded: boolean }) => unknown;
}>();

const context = useCodeBlockContext();
const expanded = computed(() => context?.expanded.value ?? false);
const button = useTemplateRef<{ $el?: HTMLElement }>('button');

async function toggle() {
  if (!context) {
    return;
  }

  const collapsing = expanded.value;
  context.setExpanded(!collapsing);

  if (collapsing) {
    await nextTick();
    const block = button.value?.$el?.closest?.('[data-slot="code-block"]');
    block?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    v-if="context?.collapsible.value"
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs()"
    ref="button"
    type="button"
    data-slot="code-block-expand-button"
    :data-state="expanded ? 'open' : 'closed'"
    :variant="props.variant"
    :size="props.size"
    :aria-expanded="expanded"
    :aria-controls="context.contentId.value"
    class="sigma-ui-code-block__expand-button"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
    @click="toggle"
  >
    <slot :expanded="expanded">
      {{ expanded ? props.collapseLabel : props.expandLabel }}
      <ChevronDownIcon
        class="sigma-ui-code-block__expand-icon"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
    </slot>
  </Button>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__expand-button {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__expand-button:hover {
  color: var(--foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__expand-icon {
  transition: transform 150ms ease;
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__expand-button[data-state='open'] .sigma-ui-code-block__expand-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sigma-ui-code-block__expand-icon {
    transition: none;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
});

defineSlots<{
  /** A `CodeBlockTitle` or `CodeBlockTabsList`, then `CodeBlockActions`. */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs()"
    :as="props.as"
    :as-child="props.asChild"
    data-slot="code-block-header"
    class="sigma-ui-code-block__header"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />

</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__header {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.375rem 0.25rem 0.875rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--code-block-border);
  background-color: var(--code-block-header);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__header:has(> [data-slot='code-block-tabs-list']) {
  padding-left: 0.375rem;
}

[data-size='sm'] .sigma-ui-code-block__header {
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.125rem 0.25rem 0.125rem 0.625rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

[data-size='sm'] .sigma-ui-code-block__header:has(> [data-slot='code-block-tabs-list']) {
  padding-left: 0.25rem;
}

[data-variant='destructive'] > .sigma-ui-code-block__header {
  border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 30%, var(--border));
  background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 8%, var(--code-block-header));
  color: var(--code-block-destructive-foreground);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import { TabsRoot, type TabsRootEmits, type TabsRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TabsRootProps>(), {
  activationMode: 'automatic',
});
const emits = defineEmits<TabsRootEmits>();

defineSlots<{
  /** A `CodeBlockHeader` with a `CodeBlockTabsList`, then one `CodeBlockTabsContent` per tab. */
  default?: (props: { modelValue: string | number | undefined }) => unknown;
}>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <TabsRoot
    v-slot="{ modelValue }"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    data-slot="code-block-tabs"
    class="sigma-ui-code-block__tabs"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot :model-value="modelValue" />
  </TabsRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 1.75rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  padding: 0 0.625rem;

[data-size='sm'] .sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger {

.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger svg {

.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger:hover {

.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger[data-state='active'] {
  background-color: var(--background);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--code-block-border), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%);
  color: var(--foreground);

.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger:focus-visible {

.sigma-ui-code-block__tabs-trigger:disabled {

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, useAttrs, useId } from 'vue';
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { useCodeBlockContext } from '@/components/ui/code-block/code-block-state';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
});

defineSlots<{
  /** A file name or a label, with an optional leading icon. Long titles truncate. */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();

const context = useCodeBlockContext();
const generatedId = useId();
const id = computed(() => (attrs.id as string | undefined) ?? generatedId);

onMounted(() => {
  if (context) {
    context.titleId.value = id.value;
  }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (context?.titleId.value === id.value) {
    context.titleId.value = undefined;
  }
});
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs()"
    :id="id"
    :as="props.as"
    :as-child="props.asChild"
    data-slot="code-block-title"
    class="sigma-ui-code-block__title"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__title {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--foreground);
  font-weight: 500;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__title svg {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 0.875rem;
  height: 0.875rem;
  margin-right: 0.375rem;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  pointer-events: none;
  vertical-align: -0.125rem;
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__title a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__title a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}

[data-variant='destructive'] .sigma-ui-code-block__title,
[data-variant='destructive'] .sigma-ui-code-block__title svg {
  color: var(--code-block-destructive-foreground);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';
import { WrapTextIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';
import { Button, type ButtonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useCodeBlockContext } from '@/components/ui/code-block/code-block-state';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  /** Accessible name of the toggle. Its pressed state is announced separately. */
  label?: string;
  /** Visual style of the button. */
  variant?: ButtonVariants['variant'];
  /** Size of the button. */
  size?: ButtonVariants['size'];
}>(), {
  label: 'Wrap lines',
  variant: 'ghost',
  size: 'icon-xs',
});

defineSlots<{
  /** Replaces the wrap icon. */
  default?: (props: { wrap: boolean }) => unknown;
}>();

const context = useCodeBlockContext();
const wrap = computed(() => context?.wrap.value ?? false);

function toggle() {
  context?.setWrap(!wrap.value);
}
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs()"
    type="button"
    data-slot="code-block-wrap-button"
    :data-state="wrap ? 'on' : 'off'"
    :variant="props.variant"
    :size="props.size"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :aria-pressed="wrap"
    :disabled="!context || $attrs.disabled"
    class="sigma-ui-code-block__wrap-button"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
    @click="toggle"
  >
    <slot :wrap="wrap">
      <WrapTextIcon aria-hidden="true" />
    </slot>
  </Button>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-code-block__wrap-button {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__wrap-button:hover,
.sigma-ui-code-block__wrap-button[data-state='on'] {
  color: var(--foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-code-block__wrap-button[data-state='on'] {
  background-color: var(--accent);
}
</style>
